resources.string: This app asks Keyra to type a login after you press Keyra\'s button. It never sees or keeps your passwords.
In Keyra\'s web app open Settings → Apps and agents, create a token of the kind \"App\" and paste it here. To scan its QR code, use your camera app, copy the text and paste it.
A token is saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.

plurals.name: connection_ok
plurals.item: Connected. This token can use %1$d login.
Connected. This token can use %1$d logins.

resources.string: Enter an address such as http://keyra.local or http://192.168.4.1. Plain HTTP is allowed only for addresses on your local network.
A token starts with keyra_ followed by 32 letters and digits.
The saved token can no longer be read on this phone. Paste the token again.
None yet. When you pick a login for an app or site, you can remember the choice.
This app keeps only Keyra\'s address, the access token (encrypted with a key in the Android Keystore) and the apps and sites you chose. No passwords, usernames or codes are ever stored on the phone.
No logins are available to this token.
Put the cursor in the field on the device Keyra types into, then press the button.
Keyra saves this login when you press its button.
Cancelled. Nothing was typed or saved.
Time ran out. Nothing was typed or saved.
Lost contact with Keyra. Check Keyra itself for the result.
Can\'t reach Keyra. Check that the phone is on Keyra\'s Wi-Fi or the same home network, and the address in Settings.
Keyra is locked. Unlock it in its web app, then try again.
Keyra does not accept this token. It may have been revoked: create a new one in Keyra\'s web app.
Keyra is waiting for another request. Long-press its button to cancel that request.
Too many requests. Try again in %1$d s.
This login is not available to this token.
This token cannot do that. Create a token of the kind \"App\".
Keyra\'s clock is not set, so it cannot make a 2FA code yet.
Set up the connection to Keyra first.
Made by Keyra\'s hardware random generator and not stored anywhere. To keep it, save the login to Keyra.
Copied. The clipboard is cleared in 60 seconds.
Keyra is ready (%1$s): tap the field if needed, then press Keyra\'s button.
Keyra adds this login after you press its button. Nothing is kept on the phone.
